notes: SharkEYE recording fix: dropped to the encoder-safe 960x640 @ 15fps preset (the 1440x960 I had was too much for the head unit's encoder, which caused the 'waiting for cameras'/no clips and made the blind-spot laggy). The blind-spot feed is now published ahead of the recording encode so it stays smooth. If recording still won't start, the SharkEYE 'Helper:' line now shows a live cap/enc count to pinpoint it.
